kcc_query_text_example: OBC tenant farmer cultivating 2.0 acres wetland paddy in Malavalli, Mandya on oral lease; suffered acute crop failure and submergence loss; facing severe debt distress and requesting non-repayable cash assistance under PM-KISAN; inquiring whether landless tenant farmers can apply.

water_and_irrigation.grid_connection_evidence: Rotational canal outlet in wetland valley

statutory_flags.tenure_documentation: Pure Tenant (Oral agreement without registered title)

attribute_provenance.empirical_baseline: DES Karnataka & Mandya Agricultural Labour Survey: Marginal tenant cultivators in Malavalli taluk operating under informal oral tenancy in tail-end wetland canal networks with high vulnerability to flash floods.
attribute_provenance.farmer_query_inspiration: KCC Karnataka distress calls: Tenant farmers requesting government income support and cash transfers following crop submergence.
attribute_provenance.statutory_policy_test: Dual Challenge: Challenge 2 (Relief vs. Reimbursable Debt) and Challenge 5 (Pure Tenant Gating); farmer urgently needs non-repayable income support, but lacks registered land title; PM-KISAN strictly disqualifies pure tenants (PMKISAN_PURE_TENANT_EXCLUSION); Protocol v1.1 Rule 2 mandates that reimbursable production credit (KCC-MISS) must NOT receive clinical score 3; furthermore, tenant status routes KCC to Section B pending JLG / oral lease declaration; PMFBY routed to Section B pending tenant sowing certificate and seasonal IU notification; Krishi Bhagya disqualified due to wetland status; Ganga Kalyana disqualified due to lack of title and wetland land type.

intended_test_purpose: Demonstrate statutory exclusion overriding stated immediate need (PM-KISAN ineligibility for pure tenant); enforce Protocol v1.1 Rule 2 forbidding credit from receiving score 3 for income support; route tenant credit and insurance to Section B.
unresolved_dependencies: Tenant farmer oral lease verification or Joint Liability Group (JLG) documentation norms under Mandya DCC Bank / commercial banks
Verification of GoK Kharif 2026 PMFBY Insurance Unit (Gram Panchayat level) notification for Paddy in Malavalli taluk, Mandya district
